        if (left >= right) return;

        int i = left, j = right;

            while (a[i] < pivot) ++i;
            while (a[j] > pivot) --j;

                swap(a[i], a[j]);
                ++i; --j;
            }
        } while (i <= j);
        self(left, j, self);
        self(i, right, self);
    };
    
    quicksort(1, n, quicksort);
    cout << a[(1 + n) / 2];
    return 0;
}

    Range stack[100];
    int top = 0;
    stack[top++] = {1, n};
    
    while (top > 0) {
        Range cur = stack[--top];
        if (cur.l >= cur.r) continue;
        
        int pivot = arr[(cur.l + cur.r) / 2];
        int i = cur.l, j = cur.r;
        do {
            while (arr[i] < pivot) ++i;

                swap(arr[i], arr[j]);
                ++i; --j;
            }
        } while (i <= j);
        
        if (cur.l < j) stack[top++] = {cur.l, j};
        if (i < cur.r) stack[top++] = {i, cur.r};
    }
    
    cout << arr[(1 + n) / 2];
    delete[] arr;
    return 0;
